cc:Work.dc:title: The Promised One E-Invitation
cc:Work.dc:description:
Every story has a beginning. Discover how ancient Bible stories lead to the birth of Jesus in “The Promised One.” Enjoy songs, dramatic readings, and interactive storytelling for the whole family. Everyone is welcome! Light refreshments will be served afterwards.
Childcare is available for children in first grade and younger. To register for childcare, scan the QR code or call 717.848.1700.
York Alliance Church is Located at 501 Rathton Road, York PA, 17403
